bays.note: THE MODULES MOUNT ON THE FRONT PLATE, NOT INSIDE IT. The front view punches four openings 3.54in [90] across and 1.42in [36] tall; a module's 108.97 plate covers its opening, its thumb-knobs landing in the pair of holes either side (3.91in, 99.4 apart on the panel drawings), and only the adapter block behind passes through. So each bay is the module plate's 108.97 x 35.05, centred on its opening, and `opening` is the hole an empty slot shows. Adjacent plates stand about 1.0 apart. every FHD cassette and adapter panel this library models is in every bay's `accepts`. FS states it on this datasheet's features list ('Compatible with all FHD cassettes and panels') and prints the same loading list with every one of them as fs/fhd-1ufce does; the module face is one 4.29 x 1.38in (108.97 x 35.05) envelope.

chassis.note: spec table: 1.73 x 19.00 x 7.67in (44 x 482.6 x 194.8). The top view dimensions the frame 17.45in [443.2] across and 7.67in [194.8] deep.

cutouts.note: the fixed-plate family's four 90.0 x 36.0 openings on the 110.0 pitch centred on the 482.6 plate (see fs/fhd-1ufmt-s@1's provenance.cutouts), less 19.7 into this 443.2 face.

ears.note: drawn as common/rack-ear@1 outside the body under `ears`.

envelope-faces.note: top, bottom, left and right are the envelope. The frame is OPEN - no cover, a rear cable manager with slots - which the envelope does not show; see `gaps`.

method.note: from the datasheet fhd-1ume-fiber-enclosure-datasheet.pdf: p3 front view (vector), p4 top view, p2 spec table. The front plate is the same stamping as the fixed and tilt- down 1Us - four 3.54in [90] openings on a 110 pitch, read off p3 at about 2.9 px/mm and agreeing with the tilt-down's 2400 dpi measurement to 0.5.

model.note: the product page and the enclosure selector call 70419 the FHD 1U modular enclosure; the datasheet's header prints FHD-1U-CMP400 and its title FHD-1UME. The cabling guide lists FHD-1UME. `model` takes the datasheet title and the header name is an alias.

rear-opening.note: THE BACK IS OPEN: the datasheet's assembly illustration (p3) and FS's renders (70419.p2-p5) show a punched front plate and a slotted rear cable manager with nothing between them, so a module's back is seen from behind. The rear view carries one hole per front slot, the bay's own size, mirrored because it is seen from behind, running the frame's 194.8 less a 1.0 plate; the modules' backs are projected into them where each module's own body stands, as fs/fhd-1ufce's are. The real opening is the whole back, not four holes - the holes are where a back is seen.
